protocol.json.scope: CPU READY/DONE; baseline-only pilot fixes N~6seconds; CPU0; fresh AA5x2 groups, AB7x2 groups; one excluded warmup per arm/group; alternate orders/reverse group2; no retries
protocol.json.aa_gate: max delta<=2%, min median>=5sec. First failed calibration stops all later timing; unmeasured scope recorded
protocol.json.local_gate: Both OS calibrated before any local AB. Both groups on each OS must shorten by >2delta; failure stops standard matrix, not a claim of worsening
protocol.json.standard_order: windows arithmetic,windows loops,linux arithmetic,linux loops,then remaining normal/CATCH windows then Linux
protocol.json.standard_early_stop: First unresolved calibration, first unmet primary10%+2delta target or any non-passing regression gate stops remaining matrix. No adoption with unmeasured items; local-only benefit is a separate future judgment
protocol.json.standard_caps: other normal max(3%,2delta); normal CATCH+5%; THROW CATCH+10%. Both series required; mixed result unresolved
protocol.json.no_overlap: No build, test, profiling during timing; read-only review/docs permitted
protocol.json.checksums: local/arithmetic/loops independent formula; other cases use separately recorded baseline-only reference at fixed N
limitations: AA delta not CI/drift bound; no post AB AA

audit_script:
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,statistics,base64
r=Path.cwd();o=r/'.work/cell-local-fetch-20261116/performance';sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest();start=json.loads((o/'start.json').read_text());protocol=json.loads((o/'protocol.json').read_text());result=json.loads((o/'results.json').read_text())
assert result['status']=='calibration_unresolved' and not result['comparisons']
for name,key in [('run.py','controller_sha256'),('worker.py','worker_sha256'),('protocol.json','protocol_sha256')]:assert sha(o/name)==start[key]
audit=[];counted=warm=0
for i in [1,2]:
 x=json.loads((o/f'windows-local-aa-{i}.json').read_text());indices={k:0 for k in x['samples']};q=0
 for turn,order in enumerate(x['orders']):
  for key in order:
   queries=x['cpu_queries'][q]['queries'];q+=1;first,last=queries[:2];cpu=sum(last[k]-first[k] for k in ['kernel_ns','user_ns'])/1000
   row=x['warmups_excluded'][key] if turn==0 else x['samples'][key][indices[key]]
   assert abs(cpu-row['cpu_us'])<1e-7
   if turn:indices[key]+=1;counted+=1
   else:warm+=1
 med={k:statistics.median(z['cpu_us'] for z in rows) for k,rows in x['samples'].items()};assert med==x['medians_us'];a,b=med.values();delta=100*abs(a-b)/min(a,b);assert abs(delta-x['delta_percent'])<1e-10
 audit.append({'series':i,'medians_us':med,'AA_delta_percent':delta,'audited_samples_including_warmup':q})
assert counted==20 and warm==4
data={p.name:json.loads(p.read_text()) for p in o.glob('*.json')};raw={name:{'sha256':sha(o/name),'base64':base64.b64encode((o/name).read_bytes()).decode()} for name in ['protocol.json','worker.py','run.py']}
report={'decision':'Adoption held; Windows AA delta5.167958656% exceeds2%; candidate CPU not measured, no AB or Linux calibration/standard34 timing','scope':'Fresh Windows baseline-only local pilot +20 counted +4 warmup runs; no retries','audit':audit,'data':data,'frozen_inputs':raw,'audit_script':Path(__file__).read_text(),'limitations':protocol['limitations']}
(r/'docs/measurements/2026-11-16-cell-local-fetch-performance.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');print(audit)
